Sleep Trial Period:

Do you price match or honor a price drop after purchase?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Yes, we do have a price matching policy for price drops after purchase:
Price Matching Policy:
If the price of the same new item is reduced by Avocado or by an authorized retailer within 30 days after your purchase date, we will refund the difference to your original form of payment.
Important Requirements:
You must contact our Customer Experience team within 30 days of your order date
Provide proof of the lower advertised price
The item must be identical in model, size, and color and in stock at the time of the request
The lower price must be publicly advertised and verifiable
Only offers from authorized retailers qualify — we do not match prices from auction sites, marketplaces, resellers, or unauthorized retailers
What It Does NOT Cover:
This policy applies only to future price reductions that occur after your purchase. It does not apply to lower prices, promotions, or discounts that were already available at the time you placed your order.
Promotions After Purchase:
If a promotion occurs shortly after your purchase and results in a lower price, you may contact Avocado to discuss potential refund options. You'll receive an email confirmation upon approval, and the refund may take several days to reflect based on your bank's processing times.
